metadata.title: SOAR Playbook SSPP
metadata.remarks: This SSPP defines the approved catalog, structure, and constraints for Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) playbooks. It ensures automated actions are deliberate, bounded, and accountable.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits authority, workflow, escalation, response, and forensic constraints and SHALL NOT redefine any of them.

system-characteristics.system-description: Defines the approved structure, lifecycle, and execution constraints for security automation playbooks.

system-implementation.remarks: SOAR playbooks are executable representations of pre-approved response actions. Every playbook SHALL be reviewed, approved, and bounded before execution.

playbook-scope.description: Automated data gathering and contextual enrichment actions.
Automated notification, ticketing, and workflow initiation.

playbook-requirements.statement: Each playbook SHALL explicitly define trigger conditions, preconditions, actions, and termination criteria.
Each playbook SHALL be explicitly approved by the designated SOAR Authority prior to activation.
Each playbook execution SHALL be attributable to an approving authority and execution context.
Where technically feasible, playbook actions SHALL be reversible.

playbook-preconditions.statement: Playbooks SHALL NOT execute without a valid Detection or Incident context.
Automated actions SHALL require confidence thresholds defined in the Threat Detection SSPP.
Playbooks SHALL validate affected asset scope before execution.
Playbooks SHALL check for active forensic holds and SHALL NOT execute if evidence integrity would be compromised.

playbook-forbidden-actions.statement: Playbooks SHALL NOT declare incidents, accept risk, or downgrade severity.
Playbooks SHALL NOT acquire, alter, or analyze forensic evidence.
Playbooks SHALL NOT modify system architecture, disable logging, or bypass controls.

playbook-lifecycle.statement: Playbooks SHALL be periodically reviewed and reapproved.
Playbooks MAY be immediately suspended upon misuse or unexpected behavior.
Deprecated or unsafe playbooks SHALL be retired and removed.

control-implementation.description: Controls ensure SOAR playbooks are governed, constrained, and auditable.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Automation supports incident handling only within approved procedures.
Playbook changes are managed through formal change control.
Playbook executions are logged and reviewed.

statements.statement: SOAR playbooks SHALL NOT operate outside explicitly approved contexts.
Playbooks SHALL fail closed when preconditions are not met.
Unexpected playbook behavior SHALL be treated as a control violation.
Automation SHALL never obscure accountability for actions taken.

back-matter.remarks: All SOAR Action Boundary and Evidence SSPPs SHALL enforce constraints defined in this SSPP.
